name: CSV Column Renamer / Cleaner
description: Paste a CSV, rename or reorder its columns, trim whitespace and fix encoding, then download the cleaned file.
body:
Columns (0)

Preview
howto: Paste your CSV into the input — comma or semicolon separators are auto-detected.
Keep the header checkbox on if the first row is column names.
The columns panel appears; rename any column or drag to reorder.
Click Apply column edits to preview the result.
Copy the cleaned CSV or download it as a file.
features: Auto-detects comma, semicolon or tab separators
Reorder columns by drag-and-drop or arrow buttons
Copy or download the result as .csv

faq.q: Does this handle files with quoted commas?
faq.a: Yes. Values wrapped in double quotes are parsed correctly so commas inside a cell do not break the columns.
Not directly — but you can clear its name in the editor, and the column will be dropped when you apply the changes.

faq.q: What if my file uses semicolons?
faq.a: The tool detects the separator automatically. If you use a European-style CSV with semicolons, it is handled without extra steps.
No. The CSV is processed entirely in your browser.
